description: Discover the vision and values behind Audrey P. Willis for Arkansas District 35. Audrey’s platform focuses on education, innovation, workforce development, and small business growth across West Memphis, Marion, Earle, Parkin, and Turrell. As a proven leader in technology and community service, Audrey is dedicated to creating jobs, empowering teachers, expanding access to broadband, and ensuring every family in the Delta has the opportunity to thrive and succeed.
title: PLATFORM | Audrey for Arkansas District 35
